comments.author: @3bsd69bhmdfawp9
comments.text:
Another dangerous thing about Nepal is mainly for tourists.
I should say, mainly for people who want to go to Mount Everest, though.
The nearest airport for them to drop off to go to Mount Everest is called  "Lukla Airport"
One of the most dangerous airports in the world.
One of the hardest airports in the world for landing and taking off.
A massive nightmare for every pilot, even for the local Nepalese pilots, according to one interview on YouTube. 
But the Nepalese people are some of the nicest people you will ever meet on this planet. 
That's 1000000% true. 
My humble Respect goes to everyone from the Help and Rescue teams in this tragedy. You guys are unsung heroes. You guys are the Living Saints. My Respect 🙏
My deepest condolences are for the friends and family members of every innocent victim of this tragedy, and my prayers are for each and every innocent soul who passed away in this tragedy. 😢🙏

Shangri-La is Gorgeous, but when the snow and ice from the Shangri-La and the rest of the Himalayan mountain ranges melt at the same time, massive amounts won't be too gorgeous, though.
Not only Nepal but also the rest of the regions close to the Himalayas are in trouble.
What we just witnessed about the tragedy in Nepal was a big alarm bell for every nation near the Himalayas. Global warming is not a Hoax.
My humble respect goes out to everyone involved in the help and rescue teams. 🙏
My deepest condolences to the friends and family members of the loved ones who just lost their innocent souls in this tragedy. 😢😢🙏🙏🙏😢😢
May all the innocent souls lost in this tragedy, and all the souls of the faithfully departed, Rest In Peace. 
Amen. ✝🙏✝
